one_fourth_carbs.standard: 1/4 of the meal is starchy CHO foods (not including dairy, fruits, or vegetables)

half_fruits_vegetables.definition: Make 1/2 my meal fruits and/or vegetables.
half_fruits_vegetables.standard: the meal contains at least 1/2 cup of fruit and 1 cup of non-starchy vegetables

lean_protein.definition: Choose food sources that are high in protein but low in fat.
lean_protein.standard: the main protein must be lean.
lean_protein.example: a turkey sandwich with a slice or 2 of bacon vs a BLT

drink_water.standard: water is shown with the meal or the user writes water in the description.
